description: Every chart of the Kraken's Eye dashboard with its query, so the Dashboards page can run each one in Porthole. $tentacle is the dashboard variable (the tentacle URNs in the region shown) and $load_balancer_urn, $database_urn, $functions_urn and $head_urn are URNs from the fleet description. Fleet members are selected by resource_urn because fresh Droplets report no resource_name (B-023); the Function namespace's series carry resource_urn and no other label (B-033). No query matches on resource_region_slug: the region is the one picked in the region list, and some series do not carry that label (B-026).

variables.name: tentacle
variables.from: label values of resource_urn on do.droplets.cpu_utilization

charts.title: Load balancer requests
charts.note: Insights has no request-rate metric for load balancers (A35), so requests per second are derived from the http_responses_by_status counter.

charts.title: Database transactions per minute
charts.note: Transactions committed per minute, a rate() of the pg_transactions_committed counter. pg_connections_active reads 0 between samples on a quiet cluster: on tor1 on 2026-10-09 it read 0 for an hour while this counter rose about 100 a minute and the load average moved with load.

charts.title: How to read this
charts.markdown: Each tentacle keeps its color on every chart. Start a scenario on the Porthole Stir page and watch it here a minute later.
